findings.what: UPDATED PRIVATE RANK FORECAST for the ticked pair {#37 56563521, #38 56563534}. This is a model with judgmental inputs, not a measurement. Numbers: P(bronze or better) ~0.55 (range 0.3-0.85; the 16:54Z forecast said 0.65-0.7); P(silver or better) ~0.15-0.2 (range 0.05-0.45); P(gold) ~0; P(no medal) ~0.45; central private rank ~350-450. P(max(#37,#38) > X) is unchanged at ~0.85. The drop comes from a changed premise. On private, every public variant above x138 ends either above X or below the whole copy block. X's own private rank is therefore 1 + the number of teams whose better final beats X. That count is ~110 teams at >=0.960 plus some share of the 0.954-0.959 crowd, which will hold 450-600 teams by the deadline. The share whose finals beat X is 0.5-0.9 under the tuned-variant models. Modelled rank of a file just above X: 415 (10-90% 375-455) in the most favourable 'overfit' field, where public gains are mostly selection noise, the two finals are correlated, and many teams keep an x138 copy as their second final; 500-700 in the other fields. So the 16:54Z assumption 'bronze lies inside the x138 block, so P(above block) ~ P(medal)' fails in most worlds. A medal now requires beating roughly half of the public-variant crowd on private. Our insertion (+0.0004..+0.0009 expected private) does that about half the time. Main drivers, in order: (1) the share of 0.954-0.959 variants that beat X on private (unobservable before 30 Sep); (2) field growth up to the deadline; (3) the private effect of the insertion.

findings.what:
The user's 20:33Z framing is 'one final for public, one for private'. The public-aimed slot has no medal value of its own. Medals are decided only by the private LB, where each team's score is the better of its two finals. So the second slot should hold the file that adds the most private UPSIDE on top of #37, not the best public display. A public display is only weak evidence of private upside when it comes from a knob with high embryo-to-embryo variance (DC: lab +0.0013 vs public -0.005). By this criterion:
- exp70b (our best public file) and a V*_C are acceptable second files, because they keep #37's insertion as the floor;
- #38 is the weakest second file in the grown field (r16fc-4).
This is a wording and understanding fix, not a rule.
